tools.name: get_signals
tools.description: Use this when the user asks for recent public AI crypto trading signals, optionally filtered by coin, importance, or pagination. When the user names a count ("last 5 signals"), pass it as `limit` — the card view renders exactly what was fetched, so over-fetching shows more cards than the user asked

tools.name: get_signal_details
tools.description: Use this when the user needs full details for one AI signal by ID, including review and resolution data.

tools.name: get_signal_stats
tools.description: Use this when the user asks for aggregate AI signal performance statistics over a specific period.

tools.name: get_top_traders
tools.description: Use this when the user wants ranked smart-money traders across supported exchanges with sorting and filtering.

tools.name: get_elite_leaderboard
tools.description: Use this when the user specifically asks for the elite leaderboard by SmartScore across exchanges.

tools.name: get_trader_profile
tools.description: Use this when the user needs one trader profile, including metrics and latest positions.

tools.name: get_trader_position_history
tools.description: Use this when the user asks for closed trade history of a specific trader.

tools.name: get_positions
tools.description: Use this when the user asks for current or historical smart-money positions, optionally filtered by status, source, or symbol.

tools.name: get_market_stats
tools.description: Use this when the user asks for aggregate market stats (positions, PNL, win rate), optionally scoped by source and period.

tools.name: get_exchanges
tools.description: Use this when the user asks which exchanges are currently available in TraderSpy smart-money tracking.

tools.name: get_price
tools.description: Get real-time price data for one or more crypto futures symbols. Returns current price, 24h high/low, volume, and 24h price change percentage.

tools.name: get_candles
tools.description: Get OHLCV (Open, High, Low, Close, Volume) candle data for a crypto futures symbol. Useful for charting, price history, and technical analysis.

tools.name: get_tracked_symbols
tools.description: List all crypto futures symbols currently tracked by TraderSpy with real-time candle data available.

tools.name: get_technical_indicators
tools.description: Compute technical indicators (RSI, MACD, EMA, SMA, Bollinger Bands, ATR, ADX, Stochastic, OBV, VWAP, CCI, MFI, Williams %R) for a crypto futures symbol at a specific timeframe.

tools.name: get_my_account
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about THEIR OWN TraderSpy account: Hyperliquid balance, open positions, unrealized PnL, or paper-trading account. Read-only — this connector cannot place, close or modify orders, and cannot withdraw. Requires a personal MCP connection (key from traderspy.app Settings).
